product_metadata.title: Comfort Zone CZST161BTEBK 16” Oscillating Pedestal Fan, 3-speed Options, 90-Degree Oscillating Head, Adjustable Height and Tilt, Powerful Air Flow, Black
features: 🌬️CUSTOMIZABLE AIRFLOW: Enjoy the flexibility of three-speed options with this 16" oscillating pedestal fan. Select from low, medium, or high air speeds to optimize the airflow and create the perfect environment for your comfort. Whether you prefer a gentle breeze or a powerful gust of air, this fan allows you to adjust the speed to suit your needs. Stay cool and refreshed with the versatile airflow options of this pedestal fan.

🌬️WIDE AIR COVERAGE: Experience enhanced air circulation and efficient performance with the oscillating feature of this pedestal fan. Its wide-angle oscillation ensures that the air is distributed across a broader area, reaching every corner of the room. Enjoy a refreshing and comfortable environment as the fan effectively circulates the air, creating a cool and pleasant atmosphere.

🌬️FLEXIBLE AIRFLOW DIRECTION: Customize the airflow direction with ease using the adjustable tilt feature of this fan. Simply adjust the angle of the fan head to direct the airflow precisely where you need it, providing targeted and personalized cooling. Whether you want to cool a specific area or create a gentle breeze across the room, the adjustable tilt ensures optimal air circulation exactly where you desire.

🌬️FLEXIBLE HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT: Customize the height of this oscillating pedestal fan to perfectly suit your space. With its adjustable height feature, you can easily set the fan's height anywhere between 41" and 47-3/8". Whether you want the fan to be at a lower level for a cozy seating area or raised higher for wider air distribution, the adjustable height ensures optimal positioning for efficient and comfortable cooling in any room.

🌬️SIMPLE AND SAFE OPERATION: This oscillating pedestal fan ensures ease of use and safety at every turn. The fan blades are protected by a sturdy metal safety grill, keeping your fingers and other objects safely away from the rotating blades. With a convenient push button, you can effortlessly adjust the fan speeds or turn it on and off, granting you full control over the cooling experience. Enjoy peace of mind and convenient performance with this user-friendly oscillating pedestal fan.
description: Add targeted cooling and air circulation to any room with the Comfort Zone adjustable-height 16" oscillating pedestal fan. This practical fan features three speed settings, allowing you to easily adjust the airflow to suit your space with the press of a button.

The fan easily tilts to direct the airflow exactly where you want it to go. The height of the stand adjusts from a minimum of 41" to a maximum height of 47", allowing you to adapt it to different settings and situations with ease.

The 3-speed pedestal fan offers a practical oscillation function that allows it to cool and enhance air circulation in all directions. Designed with powerful large blades for superior airflow, it's ideal for keeping larger rooms and groups cool when it's hot and humid outside.

The fan operates quietly, making it a smart choice for a wide variety of different settings and applications. A sleek pedestal fan for office or home use, it comes in a classic black finish that complements most decor styles with ease.

The 3-speed portable fan is designed with a patented Quad-Pod® base that comes pre-assembled for quick and easy setup. This unique base is designed to fold down, making it a snap to move around from one room to another or to put into storage during the winter.
